summary: [para 5] 5. SECI, in its later submission (Rejoinder dated 12.12.2024), has revised the per unit tariff, which was originally claimed initially due to additional work undertaken by the EPC contractor as a result of the revision in the project area to 182.89 hectares spread over 17 Khasras. The cost for this additional work now stands at Rs. 2,99,43,779, reduced from the earlier amount of Rs. 8,78,80,888, thereby lowering the corresponding tariff impact from Rs. 0.05/kWh to Rs. 0.02/kWh. [para 6] 6. Additionally, SECI in the main petition claimed a Change in Law event under Article 8.1 of the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) due to an increase in the GST rate on renewable energy devices from 5% to 12%, resulting in a total cost of Rs. 37,17,06,948 and requested a tariff increase of Rs. 0.22/kWh. The SECI has now revised this amount to Rs. 37,09,77,849 with the corresponding tariff impact revised to Rs. 0.20/kWh. [para 7] 7. In light of the above re-computations, SECI has prayed that the Commission direct CSPDCL to pay the Petitioner a total per unit tariff of Rs 4.22/kWh, i.e. Rs 4/kWh + Rs 0.20/kWh (change in law impact) + Rs 0.02/kWh (for additional cost due to revision in land). [para 20] 20. As submitted by the Petitioner, the Project with 100 MW (AC)/155.026 MWp (DC) Solar PV Project with 40 MW/120 MWh capacity was commissioned on 07.02.2024. This comes under the control period of the CERC (RE Tariff) Regulations, 2020. Accordingly, the tariff determination for the project is carried out as per the provisions specified in the CERC RE Tariff Regulations, 2020 [para 24] 24. Accordingly, the Commission shall determine the project-specific tariff of the Petitioner’s (SECI) project as a single part tariff, considering the year of commissioning of the project. [para 70] 70. As per Regulation 73 of the RE Tariff Regulations, 2020, the capital cost for renewable energy projects with storage is to be determined on a project-specific basis, considering prevailing market trends. The Commission has examined the capital cost details submitted by the Petitioner, SECI, and the subsequent revisions provided in its rejoinder dated 12.12.2024 and additional submission dt. 28.04.2025. SECI initially claimed a total capital cost of Rs. 8,81,99,80,653, which was later revised to Rs. 8,73,69,50,379. In this context, the Commission has undertaken a detailed prudence check and cost scrutiny of the various components submitted by the Petitioner. [para 103] 103. Accordingly, the Commission determines the project specific tariff for 100 MW(AC)/155.02 MWp (DC) Solar PV power plant with 40MW/120 MWh BESS of the Petitioner as Rs. 4.01 per unit as at Annexure-1 in terms of Section 79 (1) (a) of the Electricity Act, 2003 and Regulation 7 and 8 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions for Tariff determination from Renewable Energy Sources) Regulations, 2020. [para 105] 105. Accordingly, as against the Petitioner’s claim of Rs. 4.71 per kWh and the sought tariff of Rs. 4.22 per kWh, the Commission approves the levelized tariff of Rs . 4.01 per kWh (including the claim under change in law and on account of additional work due to revision in land area).
